Omii [S2 - 12th] 2026-03-30 2:33 AM
Celestial's Starring thoughts - 1
Introduction Hello everyone! Welcome to my not so daily recap of the day, where we will be going over what's been going on, updated gossip, challenge updates, my personal strategy, and anything I find interesting! The introduction will mostly just be me yapping about my day so feel free to skip it if you don't gaf! Without further ado let's get into todays gameplay. Challenge 1 - scav hunt Starting off with this tribe hasn't been too bad. Especially when it comes to the challenge. At first I was worried, since scavenger hunts tend to not be my strong suit. However this tribe seems to be enjoying hunting for things! Some due to worry about social shame, and others just want to seem as strong participants. So far, We're on page 8 and We've only missed 3 items. Which is not horrible. That gives us enough time to obtain the rest of page 8-10 tomorrow whenever. I took the role as the driver, pretty much wasted like 15 bucks of gas on this shit. Anyways apart from that I hope that my tribe is part of the top 2 tomorrow. First impressions This tribe has been quite the Mixed bad in first impressions. I can group them into three groups. Group 1 [Strong first impression] Group 2 [Middle of the road] Group 3 [boring first impression] Starting with Group 1 we have: Alex, Alexia, Alyx Alex - I had quite a fun time talking to them about speedrunning is the only topic we've spoken about but It's been quite a fun topic to tackle. As someone who has no experience speedrunning games, and always wanted to get into it. I can understand where they come from. Got to learn a bit of history and we might end up learning how to speedrun HK together. Alexia - A great impression too. I feel like shes just great to banter with, been having quite a fun time just talking about whatever with her and she just seems to have a really bright personality. Deffo want to keep talking to her and see where things might go. Alyx - VERY interesting first impression. She has told me a bunch of info regarding game knowledge. But also, she is just very pleasant to talk to when it comes to things she likes. Dragon ball, I got a whole lore run down. Which was pretty fun! Will be a bit tougher to crack open but hey not bad. Celestial's Starring thoughts - 2
Introduction What's good everyone, today I actually have a lot of game I want to talk about, regarding pretty much everything that happened. From winning the challenge to suddenly two abilities being used. I want to recap a bit of what has been going on during this early game part while also including some input of my own will and some tea I've found throughout this first part of the game! So yeah, lets get into it. Challenge results and sudden Eradication So essentially this blows. We ended up getting 2nd place in the comp only behind Kashi which would have granted us immunity but during this round. Two abilities were popped. The first ability used was Ryujin using Drowning tempest which was completely nullified by Shezmu's the slaughter ability which changes the format to eradication. Ultimately one of the worst things to do this first round. But alas thats two less abilities to worry about. Now that we are in that topic lets talk about... Eradication The eradication format forces us to form factions between everybody. Having around 32 people the hosts decided to do 5 factions of 5 which the possibity of Overloading which again sucks balls. During the round, I learnt about a couple of vocal players. Nevets is someone to watch out for as a leader personality willing to push their ideology and strive for personal safety, deffo rubbed people the wrong way. Ultimately, we all assumed we were going to overload leading to Times/Soda being the only two people safe. However that was not the case. Typo decided to berserk, which caused Joe, Hydro, Aqua, Typo, times, soda, Harpy into the riot. Favorable results within the Riot So just going based on first impressions I want Soda/Harpy to stay alive here, both are my fellow tribe mates and I'd hate to be down even more numbers. I do not want Joe to go home, out of almost everyone I do think that I had the most fun talking to him. Aqua seems to be fairly social so it would be a shame to see them go out early. Which leaves Times, Typo, and Hydro as the ones I'd like to go home. All for similar reasons. Celestial's starring thoughts - 3
Introduction Hello everyone! I am honestly pretty sleepy but I did want to type a little confessional I do believe that we have a lot to talk about regarding the game and honestly just want to let off some steam cause the last couple of days have been quite frustrating. So yeah, short introduction but irl has been pretty good! I went to my local record store and picked up short n sweet and a demon slayer vinyl. Also might be working there for the time being which is hella cool imo. Let's get to the game. Eradication results and 31st - Joe Alright so, after Typo beserked I was looking at results and honestly I just felt horrid. Joe going home actually made me really sad. Had a really long vc with him and I just felt horrid watching the results. After watching the Cast reveal I saw his fun fact and I was really interested to talking to him about it also learnt he worked in the cannabis industry and thats another thing im interested about. Just sucks to see someone get snubbed that fast when I wanted to play with him. A really tragic first boot and I hope that for some magical reason he gets either brought back or is able to get on a second season here. Love you dude if you read this just know I'm sad you went home <3. After eradication ended we got... Back to Tiraputi and challenge results Coming back to this fuck ass tribe has forever been humbling. I do not want to be part of it anymore and I gen mean this I feel like this tribe will have the lowest amount of people making merge. Soda doesn't care to show up and during the olympic challenge me and alyx had to two man that shit and honestly we just gave up. Alyx is a bit of a leaker and I fear that will get her in trouble. She's already thinking of usin honest abe which is wild work. Bunny cookie and Lucas are both just generally inactive players too. So I just dont see any of them making it far. Ultimately I think the only person that has a realistic chance at making it far are Harpy and Lexi HOWEVER, I do believe that Lexi has better odds at making it, just a well put player, tries at challenges, social, and strategic. While Harpy is a pretty happy go lucky person. Also speaking of Lexi Lexi's Patron and strategic talk with Mr. Celestial So. I ended up carrying out my plan. However instead of Alexia I slotted in Lexi in which I ended up finding out that Lexi's patron is Nanook NOW. Personally if they aren't lying about their patron being nanook this is awesome for me, that means that if they ever think of betraying me I can try to place a target on their back in return. HOWEVER. I personally do want to take Lexi as far as I can. Our strategy is that at the upcoming swap (if we swap) I'll challenge Lexi to a duel and have them lose on purpose. Get as many troops as possible is the strategy here. Then start mag dumping troops onto people. I feel confident with Lexi and I truly how that they are being truthful. Finally lets talk about... Tirupati losing, and the vote So ultimtely this vote is quite simple. An alliance of 4, being Alyx, Celestial, Lexi, and Harpy was formed, in which basically gives us majority control. Whilst im not the biggest fan of this alliance it just makes logical sense. Bunny and Lucas both pitched Soda to me, So I have no reason to go agaisnt it. As much as I like Soda I can not for my life put my life on the line for this dude. Just simply not worth it. Also I got Izanagi gift which is wild to me tbh. I actually get to vote while I'm able to save Wu zetians army. So unless some bullshit happens im safe. Conclusion Pretty frustrating gameplay so far, if I do say so myself, but im not in a bad position. The challenge was a mess and a little fun fact to end it, green and orange which won last challenge lost this time. Have a great night everyone and remember to stay hydrated. :).

In order to cast a vote at a sacrifice, Wu Zetian must deploy troops from her army. She may spend up to 6 troops in a single round (equivalent to 3 votes). She may also abstain from voting, spending 0 troops. If Wu Zetian votes correctly, she retains half of the troops spent that round (rounded down if necessary). If she votes incorrectly, she loses the full amount of troops she committed. 𝗜𝗺𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗮𝗹 𝗗𝘂𝗲𝗹 Each round, Wu Zetian may issue an Imperial Duel to a Herald outside of her realm (after merge, she may challenge anyone). To do so, she secretly gambles up to 8 troops. The challenged Herald must agree to the terms of the duel, though they will not know how many troops Wu Zetian has risked. If Wu Zetian wins, she gains troops equal to half the amount she gambled (rounded up) and retains all troops she wagered. If she loses, she forfeits the full amount of troops she committed. If Wu Zetian's army is ever reduced to zero troops, she may still issue a final desperate gamble to regain 2 troops. However, should she lose this duel, the victorious Herald will seize control of her vote for that round. If the victorious Herald resides in a separate realm, Wu Zetian instead loses her vote entirely for that sacrifice.

Introduction I honestly just have no words. There's just so much to talk about, within my life updates, a lot of game drama, and honestly I want to talk a bit first about my life! I am quite excited to be part of this opportunity and honestly life has been looking up for me. I feel pretty locked in within my studies and the gym has been pretty consistent. I gotta take care of myself and this game is my main distraction from that lol. So yeah, now that I got that out of the way, let's talk a bit about the actual game. So much shit happened and I'm honestly quite drained. So hey let's talk about it. Challenge results and disappointments So for the challenge we had to break into teams. I was the Mouth on this challenge and I felt like I did quite well. Despite this the ears aka Alyx ended up giving up on me after 3 columns. We spent around 1 hour in the challenge and basically to no avail. The results showed for themselves and we deadass just got last place cause of it. There was no winning that and I am ultimately disappointed by the tribe. I was quite desperate so I will break what happened next between to sections. Paranoia and my gamble So once Soda got voted out I did feel bad and after the reveal that he is La Llorona and he ended up haunting Bunny cookie not a bad move, as far as I was concerned that was probably the next boot for our tribe anyways. Either way, I ended up talking to Soda since he could still talk and I ended up telling him that I wanted him to come back. For two main reasons (that I didn't indulge to them) 1. I want Tirupati to have numbers, ultimately bringing soda back to life means that we keep the same amount of numbers, no matter what despite the loss we could afford to do so. 2. I still think I could in theory work with Soda here, I don't think he hates me and If I can frame it as Me bringing him back then he could theoretically be amazing for my game. Now lets move onto the second section. Celestial's plan to bring soda back and Cliodhanas ability Ok so, thankfully right after results I got back to work. I pitched my plan to Harpy in which she agreed, although was skeptical. She told Alyx to proc her A1 ability with Abraham Lincoln I tried to talk Alyx outside of that and I managed to stall long enough for someone else aka Cliodhana to proc her ability. However, thanks to my quickness, I was able to get Harpy, Lexi, and Alyx into the plan. Cliodhanas ability makes it so nobody can communicate in 1-1s and every chat is closed and we have only 1 big chat with the whole cast. Annoying as fuck, but due to fate. I was able to join the vc first and Alyx joined right after me. Right as she joined I got straight to work. Confirmed with Alyx that we should vote for Bunny cookie and go from there. Whilst I was paranoid I felt relief that the plan was set into motion early enough that I did not have to strategize too much in public. Celestial's Starring thoughts - 5
Introduction Hello everyone! It's been quite a long time since I've had a long confessional! So I think its about due time that I update you guys a bit on whats going on in game and with my irl. Well Again, if you dont gaf about my irl then feel free to skip this! Ultimately its all been the same, been working out, and I got my first job training today! Honestly super chill, my coworker seems hella chill, my boss seems awesome, and honestly the job place is just overall goated. I look forward to broaden my music taste while working and I hope I'm able to enjoy my job in the long term. Other than that, I believe we should start talking about the game since we have a LOT to cover, a swap, one round and the current round so yeah! lets start. Swap Alright so lets talk about it. I ended up landing in Mount Tateyama which was the tribe I wanted the least out of the three. Mount Fuji has Harpy and Lexi both which I consider closer allies. I ended up only with Soda on this tribe and for this round I just had to pray that this dude would trust in me but I do think we're on good terms at the moment. Celestial's Starring Thoughts - 6
Introduction Hello everyone! Been quite some time since we last spoke, To be exact a cycle and a swap! I finally have some free time so I wanted to write one of these long confessionals. So as always lets recap a bit about the current game state and the game state of a couple of earlier tribals! First my irl update is that I finally got my first official day of work tomorrow. I am quite excited for it, sounds like a fun time and I've been wanting to just chill. Plus I have to study for my finals so when there's no costumers Ill prolly spend my time just studying and doing org strategies as per usual. I am quite tired so my apologies for any mistake in advance. I think we should pick up where we last left off.. Nevets So essentially as I last spoke the strategy and ground work was already set up. I have been trying to save Soda for the longest possible time and it worked. Managing to get the target on Nevets and figuring out that Nevets is actually YYK Huge information to have. Ultimately the target fell on Nevets cause the amount of overplaying done during the earlier round and honestly again. I kinda just clung onto the fact that I wanted Soda to stay safe. For some reason I have this huge attatchment to Tiraputi people. Even saving the inactives seems like my job. I hate it tbh, but I have been dealt a pretty mid deck of cards so im just gonna ride along it. Nevets - apart from the overplaying this dude was actually hella chill but, the opening was simply just too open? Like, We had all the information we needed and afterwards it just became essential to the vote. Ideally I know this is your first org and all and you played well for a first time showing! Very very proud of you man hope you stick around and play other orgs. They are very fun and very inviting. Icarus, the sun, and Mulan jumpscare So essentially we had a creative challenge (I hate them) and my tribe decided to do Icarus. Ok perfect! I can work with that, Ideally my tribe put a pretty significant effort into making sure that it was all good. We ended up getting second place which is perfect. But yo for some reason I actually have some weird ass curse. Mulan popped her ability in which since we were second we had a potential 3rd Tribal going on. So essentially our break day wasn't even a break day, and with speculations that we might go into a triple elim my brain went into panic mode which lead into... Aesop curse (#2) and Leslie or Soda So, I actually got cursed by Aesop twice during my time in Tatetayama. Once during the first cycle and second during the last cycle of Tateyama. Which lead to two important events happening. 1 Soda almost fucking us over with no backstory 2 Leslie being a target by default because she is Achilles. However this led Me to do a couple of money moves... Money moves and Celestial overplays So during my time being cursed I lowkey gave up on talking. I was very much so not feeling it and I was pissed about it so I kinda just kept things quiet. Which led to Leslie being targetted by default. I was kinda pondering throughout the whole day on what I wanted to do, and I realized that I did not want Leslie gone. In the event of a triple elim coming out, having leslie whose vote count goes up by 1.5 is extremely better than Soda who has 2 votes. At the last hour or so. I decided to vote for Soda which effectively saved Leslie, I spoke to, Sim, Jules, and Snap and all seemed to be onboard almost immediately. I again overplayaed this round and lowkey regret it a bit however. It just felt good knowing that I was able to swap the vote just like that. However as things turned out we ended up winning the challenge and we voted for no one so hey! All that stress for nothing. Typo got eliminated which damn. Surprised it took this long due to bro killing Joe and now Swap time!
Omii [S2 - 12th] 2026-04-16 2:57 AM
Swap time (Igbodu) Well hey, I finally got a color that I like. Purple, however I am not sure how I currently feel about my tribe. For some fucking reason my rng decided to fuck me in the ass again and make me the sole Tateyama in this tribe. Horrid luck. Soda, Leslie, and Sim are together which is honestly kinda funny. Snap and Jules are together which leads ME TO BE ALONE. No Lexi either which fawking sucks. So now its up to me to social game the fuck out of this game and start talking to everyone. Thankfully though I landed myself in a tribe with Lucas and Harpy both which are OG tirupati and Ideally I can work with them here. Lucas seems to really like me as a teammate as he straight up told me that Mount Haku has an alliance of 4 already. This is not a bad thing for me ideally because if they get any funny ideas I can just... Wu zetian the fuck out of em. That being said Joe's legacy finally became an alliance that involves Aqua, Lilo, myself, and hydro Pretty interesting alliance because its quite literally 3 og Haku and me lol. Now, I do not want Harpy/Lucas gone so that leaves the only common denominator of Snowman Ideally if I can get my way, I can save both my allies and keep em alive. The issue is that Lucas has shown to be inactive time and time again so idk how easy it will be to save him without burning too many bridges. Either way lets talk about.. First impressions Honestly - I will not be doing Lucas or Harpy as I've already done them before so lets talk about the rest. Aqua and Lilo both have made an impact on me. Aqua as I had predicted seems to be quite an active social player, which is always nice to see. Lilo in the other hand seems to be more gentle but also having fun vibes. Both of these players have made a pretty good impression on me thus far and I'd like to work with them. Following them we got... Hydro - Pretty nice guy we have only spoken bout school and shit thus far so meh, I mean middle of the road atlaest hes active enough. Snowman - Me and this dude just don't talk and lowkey, I mean I don't really care for it but I want him gone if possible. If I can keep the net of people that talk to me around I will 100% be doing that. I want to be as well insulted as possible without apearing to be extremely well insulated. Wu zetian Imma keep this brief cause I don't have a lot to say, but I'm still using Wu zetian as 1. A messenger and 2. to recieve info from other tribes. I am currently at 31 troops which is a banger. Me and Lexi despite being far seem to be a pretty good duo with two bad ass Patrons that will help us keep going to the end game. I hope to see them there. Ideally Im gonna be able to keep building my army while also keeping close track of whats going on with Lexi Conclusion Well hey, these are all my current thoughts and game opinions. I seem to be doing quite well for myself, I just hope im able to keep that streak. I have gone to a crazy amount of tribals thus far and I hope that streak ends. Goodnight everyone, Hope everyone has a great night.

Introduction Hello everyone! Been a minute since I've last written one of these for good reason though. Work has been great but also been super busy with work and Finals. The study grind has not stopped and honestly. I been wanting to write a long confessional. I have a couple of days to study for finals so I should be fine. BUT theres a lot of game that I need to catch all of you on hey. Last time I spoke about the game we had just swapped and since then Two cycles Have happened so its time I give you guys an explanation on what is going on in game. Finding your realmmates and Lilo Alright so! Starting us off, we have to talk about the first challenge. I have been in communication with Lexi and honestly, they described it best. The failgirl tribe. I feel like I am actually cursed by the way this game has been panning out thus far. I have gone to 7 out of 9 tribals. Actually crazy to think about, like I have not been able to catch a break. Either way we had a comp where Snowman and Harpy were the guides and the rest of the team was realmmates either way long story short we lost tribal and we had to come up with a plan for survival. Lilo and Lucas, battle of the L memebers So essentially in this tribe things started off hot. Lucas told me that there was a Haku alliance made composed of, Lucas, snowman, Lilo, and Aqua obviously this was quite worrying however, I did leave a good impression on Lilo and Aqua. They decided to create a secondary alliance (that was already spoken about) which is For-Joe composed of Lilo, Aqua, myself and Hydro (and the spirit of the goat Joe) Either way things looked great thus far. For-Joe had a plan to vote out Lucas in which I personally just did not want to. I felt like for me Lucas is a very valuable asset but at this point forming with the majority was worth it. Especially since Lilo had brought in Harpy and Snowman into the vote. Therefore I decided to go with the majority here. However, everything came crumbling down. So essentially this round ended up being quite messy. Not even like half an hour into the vote. Lilo had told Lucas that he is getting voted out. Lucas reached out to Me and Harpy I saw my way into surviving with Lucas and reached out to Hydro almost immediately told him that the vote had leaked. With Lucas being Jaci and the fact that he was gonna proc his ability I decided that the best method to move forward is creating a four person alliance. This lead to the creation of 2 alliances. 1. Cha cha cha which is Me, Hydro, and Harpy then Hp services which is Me, Hydro, Harpy, and Lucas after discussing the vote with all of them. We settled on the fact that Lilo should go home. Had you told me this was gonna be how things were gonna shake out I would not believe you lol. Either way the plan was a success being a 5-3 vote. I also played this fairly well learning some valuable information in the way. Harpy told me she is Isis I was also able to figure out that Hydro is Ao Guang and Lucas is Jaci. Ultimately this round gave me a lot of net positive information and now. Jules - 21th Sad to see you go. Loved all our vcs and I hope you are doing better! Sad that we weren't able to keep working together but you're absolutely goated man. See you soon ! ! Lilo - 20th You played an incredible game and being a Kashi member deffo was strong. You're very fun to talk to and I do think that your vote out is gen robbery. Although I had a lot to do with it, I hope that you know that you as a player are great :). V v fun person to talk to and you did hold a lot of info! I am very glad to have you and although our gameplay was very brief I hope im able to spec you in a future org. Deffo do hope you come back to playing truce at some point. You full on deserve a second chance.

Celestial Starring Thoughts - 8
introduction Hello everyone! Hope everyone is doing well, I am currently doing amazing. Finals are over. I can finally breathe and take a break from studying. I think I didn't do the greatest on my first final but I did a pretty decent job on my second one. So all we gotta do is wait for results and pray that I pass the classes lol. Apart from that I am finally able to focus more in game and thankfully now I only have to deal with two classes... whenever those start. So yeah, ultimately supa happy about it. Though I won't talk too much about my life cause theres game to discuss. So let's talk about it! Swap time!! After Igbodu we made it into Euphrates in which I am swapped with, Lexi, Lucas, Snap, Henke, Archangel, Silent and Veejay I don't know 4 of these 7 players and that is pretty terrifying. All things considered, this late into the game you're finally trying to estabilize connections and the fact that I barely know anyone here scares me. As soon as I got into this tribe though I am very happy to see Lexi and Lucas both in here, me and Lexi have been pretty much only communicating via one message thanks to Wu zetian and so therefore we have finally been able to catch up in which they told me that Archangel considered me a, backstabbing snake that has been running the game first of all thanks for the compliment, second of all dayum. I barely even know you bro. I'm not gonna lie this had me WORRIED. First impression As you guys know I do this little segment whenever I swap. I won't be talking bout, Lucas, Lexi and Snap as I've already expressed my first impressions so talk about the rest. Henke and Archangel both are individuals that have been pretty fun to talk to thus far and I do think that I can work with them during this tribe. Furthermore, both of them are fun to talk to and I've had a couple of vcs with Archangel in which I was able to clear my name for the most part. Both of them are just good people and the most important part.. active lol. Silent, Veejay Both of these people just don't talk to me all that much. I want Veejay gone from this tribe mostly cause of his DP ability. Silent is just... mid? Like this dude is quiet asf barely even talks. I dunno how they have made it this far but honestly I digress. I am not the biggest fan of this tribe. Has deffo felt silent and honestly I just don't expect this type of gameplay at the F16 of an org with 32 people. Punishment challenge, challenge loss, and important information Okay so we lost the challenge, I grabbed punishment 9 which doesn't let me win two individual immunites. We still lost regardless so fuck me I guess lol. Granted from this we learnt that A person is Izanami and that only Archangel knew this information beforehand. Apart from that the challenge was a wash, other than the fact that Sim/Hydro Nuked their tribe. I wonder what is going on over there. I might send Harpy a message and try to see if I can get my way over there. See if they target who I want them to target :). We will see. Strategy going into tribal I can't like I was honestly fairly mentally checked out from this tribal. I was dealing with finals and a lot of irl shit so that had me fucked up, but honestly I was really pushing for the fact that Veejay should go here AND ALL WAS FINE AND DANDY. until like the last 30 minutes. Archangel decided to change the vote onto Snap which again I wasn't for it, but I wasn't against it. Mostly cause staying in good graces with majority is worth it. I just didn't want to kill Snap there but meh. I don't want to be the one controlling the game at the moment. It's better to lay back and let people do their own money moves. I think we can still get a Veejay blindside going next tribal if we go to one. That would be the play imo. But I have to push for it.
